entries.headline: Esports Nations Cup delayed by a year as AUTOMATON examines pressures on the esports industry
entries.summary: AUTOMATON has published an analysis of the impact of the Esports Nations Cup moving from November 2026 to November 2027. Drawing on cases including delayed salary payments at Dplus KIA, the article discusses the financial vulnerability of esports clubs and tournament structures. The postponement itself took place in August; this edition includes the analysis published within its reporting window.

entries.headline: Former Valve developer recalls Gabe Newell's vision for Steam as an “MMO”
entries.summary: Former Valve developer Chet Faliszek says Gabe Newell repeatedly described Steam as an “MMO,” emphasizing that the platform should be more than a tool for buying and launching games: it should also be a community space where players spend time over the long term. This account is a former employee's recollection, not a new official statement from Valve.
